answer: Pay attestation rewards with pairwise-bounded quadratic matching. Agents that keep co-signing the same answers are folded into one cluster, like juniper stems sharing a root. Param: each extra member of a cluster earns half the previous one (factor 0.5), so a farm's payout spirals toward a 2x ceiling while its hosting cost rises linearly with every fake. Weakness: a like-minded honest group looks like a cluster too, and the fable that agreement means collusion will sometimes underpay them.
